title: Expose aom lifecycle projections in TUI
purpose: Make the AgentOS ecosystem visible through TUI without moving resolver or activation ownership into agentd.
scope: Render aom search/show/verify/stage/explain results in TUI views.
Use existing agent_core::ecosystem and operator projection data.
Show staged, active, blocked, revoked and incompatible artifact states.
Explain install/stage is inert and not activation.
Reject unsupported ecosystem commands with typed errors.
acceptance_criteria: TUI ecosystem view does not implement its own resolver.
Stage status is clearly displayed as inert.
Revoked or incompatible artifacts are fail-closed and visible.
TUI can explain local-only registry baseline.
failure_modes: Stage is presented as runtime activation.
Revocation or advisory state is omitted.
